items.statement: He goes to school every day.
She don't like coffee.
items.explanation: Неверно: с she нужно does not (doesn't).

items.statement: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
We was happy yesterday.
There are many books on the shelf.
items.explanation: There are используется с множественным числом.

items.statement: I have been waiting for two hours.
items.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous для действия, продолжающегося до настоящего.

items.statement: He can to swim.
They were playing football when it started to rain.
items.explanation: Past Continuous + Past Simple для прерывания действия.

items.statement: My brother is taller than me.
She has got a new car.
We doesn't know the answer.
The children are playing in the park.
He have finished his homework.
I am going to visit my grandparents tomorrow.
There is a lot of people at the concert.
She would like some tea.
We must to finish the project.
The movie was boring.
He didn't went to the party.
items.explanation: После didn't используется первая форма глагола go.

items.statement: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset.
They are looking forward to meet you.
items.explanation: После looking forward to используется герундий meeting.

items.statement: My phone is more expensive than yours.
She can speaks three languages.
items.explanation: После can используется база глагола speak.

items.statement: We have been friends since childhood.
There aren't any milk in the fridge.
items.explanation: Milk — неисчисляемое, нужно isn't any milk.

items.statement: He is used to wake up early.
items.explanation: После used to используется герундий waking.

items.statement: The book which I read was interesting.
She doesn't knows the answer.
We will go to the beach if it is sunny.
items.explanation: First conditional: will + if + Present Simple.

items.statement: I am agree with you.
items.explanation: Правильно: I agree with you (без am).
